vehicle.notes: Research limited to web-search result pages (titles/snippets of eBay, parts retailers and TecDoc OE cross-reference listings); the session network blocked direct page fetches and EPC mirrors (7zap, partsouq, dealer webstores), so no number here has been checked against a VIN-based GM/Opel EPC. source_url is the search-result page judged to carry the number, but pages were not opened, so a few source_url mappings may point to a sibling listing. Verify against VIN before use in a report.

parts.notes: Listed as Corsa E (X15) front bumper on an eBay.de listing titled 'Stoßstange vorne Opel Corsa E X15 39059634', on auto128 and as an OEN on buycarparts.co.uk. Trim/PDC/headlamp-washer variant NOT established (standard vs SRi/VXR bumpers differ). Other numbers seen for Corsa E front bumper but not corroborated: 39005563 (with ref 13399247, 2015-2019, single eBay.de listing) and 39003567 (conflicting descriptions).

Seen on UK eBay listing '2017 Mk4 Vauxhall CORSA E Front Badge Grille 39003576' (stated 2014-2018) and eBay.de 'Opel CORSA E Kühlergrill 39003576 ab 2014'. Finish/trim variant (e.g. chrome bar, SRi/VXR) not established.
Seen on eBay listing for Corsa E left front wing and as Opel original number on a Winparts (Van Wezel 3804655) page for Corsa E 09.2014-06.2019. Right-hand number not found in full.

Listed as Corsa E front right door on a German retailer page and an eBay listing (2015-2018 Corsa E); one other German listing labels it front left, so side should be verified. 5-door vs 3-door not explicitly stated.
New original Opel rear left door for Corsa E from 11/2014 (france-bumper.com, Manufacturer Reference 39135551); also UK dismantler 'Door Bare Rear Left Side' and German retailer (hinten links).
Seen only as the rear-right counterpart on a German retailer's Corsa E door listing.

Halogen vs LED-DRL variant inconsistent across listings. Number 39108228 also appears in UK listings for the Corsa E left headlamp and is cross-referenced with 13381345 (possible later number; supersession not confirmed). RHD-specific fit not verified in an EPC.

UK listings: 'DRIVER SIDE HEADLIGHT/HEADLAMP 13381346 14-15', 'Headlight Right Side RHD 13381346'; also an OE cross-reference on Hella 1LF 011 830-081 (LED/halogen). Variant (halogen vs LED-DRL) unclear. 39108229 seen in listings as right-hand Corsa E headlamp cross-referenced with 13381346 (supersession not confirmed). RHD-specific fit not verified in an EPC.

eBay listing for Corsa E 5-door outer rear light driver's side (halogen) and HamCarParts right taillight under same number. 3-door uses different lamps (e.g. 39012628 seen for 3-door right). Tailgate inner lamps are separate parts.
One eBay listing gives MPN 39012621 for 5-door rear left tail light; another lists it as OE reference alongside 39090647 (relationship not stated).

eBay.de listing titled '13399547 Stoßstange hinten für Opel CORSA E'; used hatchback bumper listing and PHIRA CO-15300 (Autodoc) both list OE 13399547 together with 39002839 (which is current/superseded not shown). PDC variant not established.

Engine-specific: 1.4 B14XEL/D14XEL 90PS (66kW) per TecDoc OE cross-references on Winparts (NRF 550404, International Radiators 37012729) and Nissens 606390. Other engines use different radiators (e.g. 1300361 listed for 1.4 Turbo NEH 150PS; not verified).

Engine-specific: OE reference (with Opel catalogue no. 1850742) on Valeo 822574 for Corsa E 1.4 B14XEJ 75PS from 08.2014, also on condensers for 1.0 Turbo. Other numbers seen for other engines (39059785 for 1.3 CDTi / 1.0; 13453205) not verified. From aftermarket cross-reference data only.
